"""Copy the exemplar using 21 variable-pressure, lengthwise brush strokes.
Paths contain root centerline coordinates, brush widths, and tangents in image pixels.
Robot targets compensate the Wang tuft offset and measured PD tracking delay.
"""
import os,time,json, argparse
import numpy as np
from scipy.interpolate import CubicSpline
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
BASE=os.path.dirname(__file__)
def generate(score=True,rate=.25,tau=.097):
 s=Session('/app/instance.json',render=False);p=s.primitives();s.record_start()
 p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.06],speed=.10,settle=5)
 p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.025],speed=.03,settle=10)
 p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.05],speed=.04,settle=5)
 paths=np.load(BASE+'/paths.npz');t0=time.time();real=[]
 for si in range(len(paths.files)):
  data=paths[f'p{si}'];uv=data[:,:2];w=data[:,2]*s.geo.px_m
  # light regularization prevents raster staircase noise from entering the robot command.
  depth=np.maximum((w+.0003)/1.187,.00023)
  offset=np.maximum(0,(-.967*(depth*100)**2+2.109994*(depth*100)-.036001727)/100)
  xy=np.c_[s.geo.px_to_world(uv[:,0],uv[:,1])]
  direction=-data[:,[4,3]]
  desired=np.c_[xy+offset[:,None]*direction,.020-depth]
  # Allocate enough time for changes in depth and tuft bend as well as translation.
  distances=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(desired,axis=0),axis=1)*1000
  timeline=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.maximum(distances/rate, .45))]*.05
  ts=np.arange(0,timeline[-1]+.0001,.05)
  if ts[-1]<timeline[-1]:ts=np.r_[ts,timeline[-1]]
  spline=CubicSpline(timeline,desired,axis=0)
  ref=spline(ts);vel=spline(ts,1)
  start=ref[0].copy();start[2]=.035
  pos=s.tip_pose()[0].copy();pos[2]=.045;p['move_tip'](pos,speed=.04,settle=3)
  p['move_tip'](start,speed=.10,settle=5)
  p['move_tip'](ref[0],speed=.01,settle=8)
  for xyz,v in zip(ref,vel):
   q,ok,err=s.ik(xyz+tau*v)
   if not ok:raise RuntimeError((si,xyz,err))
   s.step(q)
  q,ok,err=s.ik(ref[-1]);s.step(q);p['hold'](4)
  lift=ref[-1].copy();lift[2]=.035;p['move_tip'](lift,speed=.015,settle=5)
  print('stroke',si+1,'steps',s.n_steps,'time',round(time.time()-t0,1),flush=True)
 actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,BASE+'/trajectory.npz')
 Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(BASE+'/canvas.png');np.save(BASE+'/ink.npy',s.ink())
 strokes=s.strokes();np.savez(BASE+'/realized.npz',**{f's{i}':st['samples'] for i,st in enumerate(strokes)})
 if score:
  metrics=s.score();json.dump(metrics,open(BASE+'/metrics.json','w'),indent=2);print(json.dumps(metrics,indent=2),flush=True)
 print('SAVED',actions.shape,'sha',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
 return s
if __name__=='__main__':
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--no-score',action='store_true');ap.add_argument('--rate',type=float,default=.25);ap.add_argument('--tau',type=float,default=.097);args=ap.parse_args()
 generate(not args.no_score,args.rate,args.tau)
